meta.title: Launch webinar — September 5, 2026
meta.description: BellumAI launch webinar, September 5, 2026. Live demo: how to turn a company name into a complete account brief for IT services firms — decision-makers, buying signals, action plan. Free registration, replay sent to everyone who signs up.

hero.subtitle: See live how BellumAI turns a company name into a complete account brief — decision-makers, buying signals, an action plan and ready-to-send messages. Prospecting for IT services firms, reinvented.

agenda.title: What happens during the 45 minutes.
agenda.subtitle: A dense, hands-on session: the problem, a real live demo, IT-services use cases, your questions, then an offer reserved for attendees.
agenda.note: Live · about 45 minutes · hosted by Louis and Théo

segments.title: The problem
segments.desc: Researching instead of selling: 15 open tabs, stale data, the wrong contact. The problem isn't motivation — it's context.

segments.title: Live demo
segments.desc: An analysis launched live on a real account: company profile → account brief → buying signals with their sources → decision-makers & org chart → message → CRM export.

segments.title: IT-services use cases
segments.desc: Opening an account, prioritizing your portfolio, preparing a meeting, catching a buying signal, spotting the competitors already in place. What it changes in your week.

segments.title: Q&A
segments.desc: Sources and reliability, GDPR, pricing and credits, LinkedIn, CRM, security: we answer live in the chat, no corporate-speak.

segments.title: Early-adopter offer
segments.desc: A personalised demo on an account of your choice for everyone, and a limited number of early-adopter onboarding spots reserved for the IT services firms attending.

speakers.title: Who hosts the webinar.
speakers.subtitle: Two co-founders, two complementary perspectives: the product and the IT-services field.

items.role: Co-founder — former Business Manager at an IT services firm

replay.title: Register to receive the replay.
replay.desc: The webinar is recorded. Everyone who registers receives the replay by email, whether they attend or not — plus short clips (the demo, "where does the data come from") to review at your own pace.

intro.title: Save your seat.
intro.subtitle: Tell us who you are. You'll receive the connection link by email, a reminder before we go live, and the replay afterwards.
highlights: A live demo on a real account — suggest yours in the chat.
Where every piece of information comes from: full source transparency, no made-up data.
How to prioritize your portfolio and catch the signals nobody is watching.
An early-adopter offer reserved for attendees.
